requires.label: Services must be received at a National Jewish Health location
requires.quote: We offer financial assistance only for health care services received at one of our locations.

application.quote: You have up to 240 days after the date of your initial patient responsibility statement to apply.

payment_plan.quote: Start a payment plan arrangement with National Jewish Health. This will help you manage your account while your application is processed.

notes: Financial assistance may help pay for co-insurance and deductible amounts but does not apply to co-payment amounts for physician services.
Financial assistance does not apply to any patient balance amounts required by Medicaid or other need-based programs.
Financial assistance is not available when your insurance plan denies access to National Jewish Health.
Application may require copies of tax returns, bank statements, and pay stubs; missing information will delay the application.
Complete applications receive a response within 20 business days.
If you do not make payments and do not contact us about payments, we may use a collection agency.
Policy, summary, and application available in English, Spanish, French, Arabic, Russian, Chinese, Korean, and Vietnamese at www.njhealth.org/FinancialAssistance.
Financial assistance does not cover travel, food, lodging, medical equipment, or drug expenses.
Schedule 1 (Income and Discount Schedule), Schedule 2 (Application), Schedule 3 (AGB), and Schedule 4 (Billing and Collections) are referenced but not included in the provided text.

Eligibility is based on insurance coverage, income, family size, assets, and other issues per the policy text, but specific income thresholds and discount percentages are defined in Schedule 1 which is not provided.

rules.label: Financial Assistance - Medically Required Services
rules.quote: We offer financial assistance for services that are medically required.

rules.label: Financial Assistance - Location Restriction
rules.quote: We offer financial assistance only for health care services received at one of our locations.

application.quote: You have up to 240 days after the date of your initial patient responsibility statement to apply.

payment_plan.quote: Start a payment plan arrangement with National Jewish Health. This will help you manage your account while your application is processed.

notes: Eligibility based on insurance coverage, income, family size, assets, and other issues, using Federal Poverty Level guidelines (see Schedule 1).
Application may require copies of tax returns, bank statements and pay stubs.

Financial assistance may help pay for co-insurance and deductible amounts, but does not apply to co-payment amounts for physician services or patient balance amounts required by Medicaid or other need-based programs.
Financial assistance is not available when your insurance plan denies access to National Jewish Health.
Financial assistance information is sent with billing statement; application attached on Schedule 2.
Policy, summary, and application available in multiple languages via website.
Complete application should receive a response within 20 business days.
If no payments made and no contact about payments, may use a collection agency.
Policy posted in many places and on signs in admission and registration areas.
If you qualify for financial assistance, you cannot be charged more than the amounts generally billed.
